mapper.select:
select r.task_id as taskId, #{item.endTime} as statisticalTime, #{item.offsetValue} as second, avg(r.tx_bps) as txBps from mp_flow_task_record r left join mp_flow_task_task t on t.id = r.task_id where t.task_status = 1 and r.record_status = 1 and r.task_id in
#{record}
and r.create_time <= #{item.endTime} and r.create_time > #{item.startTime} group by r.task_id
order by taskId,statisticalTime
select min(create_time) as firstTime from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in (select id from mp_flow_task_task where scene_id=#{sceneId})

select #{item.endTime} as statisticalTime, #{item.offsetValue} as offsetValue, #{item.offsetUnit} as offsetUnit, ifnull(sum(tx_bps),0) as txBps, ifnull(sum(tx_pps),0) as txPps, ifnull(CAST(avg(latency) as int),0) as latency, ifnull(CAST(avg(jitter) as int),0) as jitter, ifnull(sum(total_tx_L2),0) as totalTxL2, ifnull(sum(total_tx_L1),0) as totalTxL1, ifnull(sum(total_rx),0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(queue_full),0) as queueFull, ifnull(sum(drop_rate),0) as dropRate from mp_flow_task_record where (task_id,create_time) in (select task_id,max(create_time) from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in (select id from mp_flow_task_task where scene_id=#{sceneId}) and create_time <= #{item.endTime} and create_time > #{item.startTime} group by task_id)
order by statisticalTime

select #{item.endTime} as statisticalTime, #{item.offsetValue} as offsetValue, #{item.offsetUnit} as offsetUnit, ifnull(sum(obytes),0) as obytes, ifnull(sum(oerrors),0) as oerrors, ifnull(sum(total_pps),0) as totalPps from mp_flow_task_record where (task_id,create_time) in (select task_id,max(create_time) from mp_flow_task_record where task_id in (select id from mp_flow_task_task where scene_id=#{sceneId}) and create_time <= #{item.endTime} group by task_id)
order by statisticalTime

select node_name as nodeName,sum(tx_bps) as txBps from mp_flow_task_task t,mp_flow_task_record r where t.id=r.task_id and scene_id=#{sceneId} and task_status='1' and (r.task_id,r.create_time) in( select task_id,max(r1.create_time) as create_time from mp_flow_task_task t1,mp_flow_task_record r1 where t1.id=r1.task_id and scene_id=#{sceneId} and task_status='1' group by task_id) group by nodeName order by txBps desc
